  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JANUARY 10, 2025

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Negrete at 2:34 p.m., on
  Friday, January 10, 2025, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Lana Negrete
  Mayor Pro Tem Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 2:34 p.m., with all
  members present. Mayor Pro Tem Torosis led the assemblage in the Pledge
  of Allegiance and recited the land acknowledgement.

  PUBLIC INPUT ON  Members of the public Shannon Yoshikowa, Margarita Padia, Scott
  REMAINING AGENDA  Martlette, Kay Ambriz, Kurt Gonska, Assemblymember Rick Chavez Zbur
  ITEMS:  (time donated by Robert Oliver), Hank Koning, Adam Finkel, Bobby
  Shriver, Ericka Lesley, and John C. Smith commented on Item 14.A.

  RESOLUTIONS:  14.A. Confirm and Ratify Proclamation of Local Emergency Due to
  LOCAL EMERGENCY  Palisades Fire, was approved.

  Recommended Action
  Staff Recommends that the City Council:
  1. Adopt resolution ratifying Proclamation of Local Emergency Due to
  Palisades Fire; and
  2. Adopt a finding of no possible significant effect on the environment
  under CEQA Guidelines.

  Questions asked and answered of staff included what is the turnaround time
  for the waving of Conditional Use Permits (CUPs) for schools in non-school
  zones and what is the definition of temporary in this regard; preferential
  parking suspension; how is anti-price gouging being enforced and who
  should be contacted if someone believes they are a victim; prioritizing of the

  1  January 10, 2025

  below market housing wait list; does the Council need to reconvene to adopt
  any amendments going forward; effective term for the emergency order;
  extending building permits for projects that cannot be completed at this time
  as a result of the fires, ability to collect data from websites of current
  available rentals; are there processes in place to prohibit illegal home
  sharing; concerns with open burning including covered firepits during this
  time; suspension of leasing regulations; are non-profits considered
  businesses for the purpose of waiving CUPs; and what constitutes a primary
  residence.

  Considerable discussion ensued on topics including, but not limited to
  creating a rental list; waiving building and permit requirements; prioritizing
  people who qualify for below market housing who have been displaced by
  any of the fires in Los Angeles County; flexibility of the Building Official to
  waive certain requirements to allow for schools; allowing the suspension of
  CUPs for displaced local businesses; and lengths of time established for the
  relaxation of home sharing regulations.

  Motion by Mayor Pro Tem Torosis, seconded by Councilmember Snell, to
  adopt the staff recommendation. The motion was approved by the following
  vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Zernitskaya, Snell, Raskin, Hall, Zwick
  Mayor Pro Tem Torosis, Mayor Negrete
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 3:58 p.m. in
  memory of all those who have lost family, friends, loved ones and property
  during the fires.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Nikima S. Newsome  Lana Negrete
  City Clerk  Mayor

  2  January 10, 2025
